headline: Executive order makes 2022 updates to the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military criminal trials.
what_it_does: This order changes the Manual for Courts-Martial, which sets the rules for how the U.S. military investigates, charges, tries, and punishes service members accused of crimes. Presidents update this manual from time to time by executive order. No summary was provided, so the specific changes cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the U.S. armed forces
who_it_affects.how: The updated rules apply when service members are charged with offenses and tried in military courts.
They must follow the revised procedures and rules when handling military justice cases.
